field_edits.updated_text: There is near‑complete resolution of the previously noted marrow edema/bone contusions involving the acetabular walls, femoral head, femoral neck, and greater trochanter. No subchondral collapse, fracture, acute fracture, avascular necrosis, or aggressive osseous lesion is seen. Normal marrow signal is demonstrated.
There is a minimal residual hip joint effusion, markedly decreased compared to the prior study. No trochanteric bursitis.

impression:
